accepted_design: Reconstructs immutable v1/v2/v3 union before admitting explicit nonoverlapping source deltas; current HEAD is not used to authorize inputs.

Each delta binds fixed source/review commits, complete changed-path inventory, before/after hashes, pinned review bytes and accepted_scoped verdict; final complete inventory and bytes must equal fixed PRODUCT.
Nine original helpers/registries match BASE byte-for-byte and are checked using direct stdlib Git reads, independent of the helper under verification.
Full 40-hex pin validation rejects floating references; CLI rejects optimized Python before inherited assert-based validation.
Historical v3 CI transition is now verified against fixed BASE; current CI remains constrained to the exact selector and explanatory-comment migration.
validation_scope: Read complete new guard and 13 controls, inspect two historical-test migrations and actual CI diff; independently verify original file bytes, registry digest and review binding. Author test session not rerun or claimed independently executed.
followup_constraint: Adding the capture delta requires an explicit new version, fixed product union and source/review pins. This design acceptance is bound to the file hashes above and grants no quality/100k certification.
